svg.title: PS mapping completeness and incorrect mappings
svg.desc: The course report pages 3 through 6 show zero unmapped PS reads in every test. Incorrect mappings for 1M/a, 5M/a, 20M/a, 1M/b, 5M/b, 20M/b are 1, 3, 0, 0, 4, 0 respectively, with 1,000 reads per test. These are course results, separate from the development-slide checks.
